title: The moss observatory
alt: A tiny library and telescope inside a glass terrarium with a winding wooden staircase.
description: An illustrated cutaway connects a tiny library, a spiral stair and a glass observatory.
prompt: An exquisite cutaway architectural illustration of a tiny astronomical observatory built inside a huge weathered pear-shaped terrarium. A copper telescope sits beneath a movable glass dome at the top; winding wooden stairs lead down past a library of miniature books, a botanical laboratory, a warm kitchen and a moss garden at the bottom. Clear plausible stair connections, detailed furniture and little amber lamps; all rooms are visible in one coherent sectional view. Hand-painted gouache and delicate pencil, luminous sage, apricot, deep teal and warm ivory. The terrarium rests on a stone ledge with tiny ferns around it. Intricate, enchanting, beautifully designed, no people and no text.
